status: fixed BEFORE the run (LR4, 2026-10-08); development check, not a research run
source: plan v2.0 section 10.2 (decoder metric change <= .01 on the development test panel); plan change AE-01 left this part open until LR4

panel.sizes: study_defaults.data_per_context (train 1000 / val 250 / test 1000), episode ids 0..n-1 per split
panel.pipeline: runner.run_context: RK4 trajectories, features via observation.observe, Ridge fit on train with lambda on val, test scoring; one complete pipeline per dt

reference_reason: RK4 at dt/4 = 0.005 had 1.4e-9 rad maximum error on the LR2 ODE panel against solve_ivp (AE-01); the same RK4 code at a quarter step is the reference for the full decoder pipeline

metrics.G: per (context, condition, task, time): 2 x 4 x 2 x 7 = 112 cells
metrics.also_reported: S per cell, the selected lambda per cell, the maximum circular state difference over all episodes and times

criterion: max over cells |G(dt 0.02) - G(dt 0.005)| <= 0.01 AND max over curves |A(dt 0.02) - A(dt 0.005)| <= 0.01; the dt 0.01 comparison is reported, not gated

pipeline_gate_plan_10.A: immediate readout: mean over the development contexts of G(task A, t = 0) > 0.90 for every condition (at t = 0 all conditions share the same states)
pipeline_gate_plan_10.B: immediate readout must be target-independent: structurally tested in LR3 (identical B features for u and -u at t = 0); G(task B, t = 0) is reported, no 0.90 rule

use_of_values: development values only: they are not used to choose any protocol value; contexts 0 and 1 of the development study are not research contexts; no research claim follows from them
expected_runtime: about 55 min on this PC (25 ms per episode and condition at dt 0.02, measured; 4x at dt 0.005)
